story: Boston led by 34 in the second quarter. Washington cut it to 117–112 with 3:19 left.
aria: Animated Short: Jayson Tatum drives for a finger roll, assisted by Paul George, with 3:06 left to put the Celtics up 119–112 at Washington after the Wizards had cut a 34-point lead to five. Celtics win 131–116. An original illustration, not traced from footage, not to scale.
